ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ascent uses your location to log your day only when you get to the gym.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: With Always, your day logs itself when you get to the gym, even if you don't open the app.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: With Always, your day logs itself when you get to the gym, even if you don't open the app.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ascent doesn't record audio. It only plays the end-of-rest alert.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Ascent reads your steps and workouts so it doesn't miss a day your phone already knows you trained.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Ascent only reads your steps and workouts from Health; it doesn't save or change anything in Health.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ascent uses your photos to add today's photo to your log.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ascent uses the camera to take today's photo.
